name: The Abyssal War
author: Tristan
description: The Threat does not stay in the abyss. Once woken, the fabricator swarms colonise the sector's fringe - hive worlds that turn metals and fuel into strata, the one substance that is their size, their defences, their fleets and their armies - then strike outward at inhabited space, occupying human worlds and eating their industries. Fight the hive, not just the fleets: run your colonies' war from one board, deploy fleets, send and receive aid, and burn, starve or overrun each hive until its strata reach zero. Standalone; pairs with Remnant Retribution. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
